prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animated astronaut SPRITESHEET for a 2:1 isometric lunar game, true transparent PNG. Reference images are STYLE references only: match their polished soft low-poly 3D, warm ivory ceramic, charcoal hardware, mustard gold accents, dark navy glass, gentle upper-left lighting, rounded chunky forms for children aged 7–12. Design ONE consistent friendly astronaut: compact ivory spacesuit with subtle faceted surfaces, modestly large rounded helmet with a single dark navy reflective visor and pale blue highlight, gold collar and wrist/boot trim, charcoal flexible joints, stout dark boots, small ivory life-support backpack with gold clamps, simple chest controls. No face visible, no words, logos, weapons, tools, extra props, backgrounds, shadows or terrain. Produce EXACTLY 32 separate full-body sprites in an EXACT 8-column by 4-row contact sheet, canvas 1536x1024. Every cell is 192x256, with generous transparent gutters; no sprite touches or overlaps another cell. All figures have identical size, outfit, lighting, proportions, and camera angle. Feet centered near cell coordinate (96,228); helmet top near y55. Always include both boots and whole helmet. Row 1: astronaut facing screen SOUTHWEST (front-left three-quarter). Row 2: facing screen SOUTHEAST (front-right three-quarter). Row 3: facing screen NORTHEAST (back-right three-quarter, show backpack). Row 4: facing screen NORTHWEST (back-left three-quarter, show backpack). Do NOT rotate the entire sheet or render a turnaround perspective camera; the fixed elevated orthographic camera sees each figure. In EACH row, COLUMN 1 is a calm standing idle pose with both feet planted. COLUMNS 2–8 are seven sequential distinct frames of a smooth low-gravity walking loop in that row's facing direction: left boot forward/right arm forward; passing with leg lift; right boot forward/left arm forward; passing; opposite contact; lifted passing; return-to-contact. Clear alternating arm and leg motion, small consistent helmet bob, grounded feet, coherent full-body poses, no motion blur. No repeated static copies masquerading as walk frames. No gridlines, labels, borders, captions or cast shadows. Transparent alpha everywhere outside the astronaut silhouettes. One finished game atlas only.
